desc: combine three PGM images (R, G, B) into one PPM image
r: rgb3toppm - combine three PGM images (R, G, B) into one PPM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

rgb3toppm reads three PGM images as input, taking each to represent one component (red, green, and blue) of a color image. It produces a PPM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for rgb3toppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
